title: Harden lifecycle recovery and Tauri contract evidence
summary: Adds fail-closed terminal lifecycle evidence reconciliation, exact Tauri route-semantic validation, hermetic recovery controls, explicit primary-navigation keyboard coverage, API inventory drift guards, and a promoted-layout audit helper regression.
reason: Terminal failed recovery evidence could block backend work without a narrowly scoped archive transaction; the Tauri shell only required route presence rather than exact confirmation, fingerprint, journal, and schema metadata; recovery UI coverage did not exercise the full backend-owned preview/apply flow; API documentation counts and command-effect summaries could drift; and the promoted audit helper resolved bundled tools from its new module directory instead of the canonical entrypoint root.
behavior_before: A conclusively terminal failed lifecycle recovery chain had no exact, fingerprint-bound archive workflow; Tauri accepted reconciliation routes based on presence alone; Diagnostics lacked the backend-owned recovery action; primary navigation keyboard behavior lacked complete browser and native-shell evidence; API inventories did not guard all subgroup and effect totals; and audit executable lookup could use the wrong promoted-layout anchor.
behavior_after: Hermetic tests now prove that only a correlated terminal failed lifecycle recovery chain can be previewed and archived after literal confirm_apply=true and an exact dry-run fingerprint. The apply route is durably journaled, Tauri validates request keys, safe defaults, strict booleans, fingerprint, confirmation, journal, response schema, and data schema exactly, Diagnostics stages preview before apply, primary navigation has explicit Enter/Space coverage, API inventories are executable-test guarded, and audit tool lookup anchors at the canonical entrypoint root. Invalid live-system runs listed below are excluded from acceptance evidence.
tests_added: Lifecycle reconciliation service tests cover missing, mismatched, live-PID, active-reservation, fingerprint-drift, transaction-intent, durable-archive, and recovery-replay cases under temporary roots.

Local API tests enforce caller-selected-evidence rejection, literal confirm_apply=true, non-empty dry-run fingerprints, preview suppression from the command journal, and strict durable apply journaling.

Tauri Rust tests reject drift in reconciliation request-key order or expansion, JSON-boolean safe defaults, strict confirmation metadata, dry-run fingerprint requirements, journaling, effect, response schema, and data schema.
Hermetic browser tests stage Diagnostics lifecycle preview/apply against disposable backend state and prove the frontend cannot supply evidence paths, PIDs, command IDs, or record IDs.
Browser and native-shell probes cover explicit Enter and Space activation for every primary navigation destination while preserving focus and suppressing repeated Enter activation.
API route inventory tests pin route totals, subgroup totals, command-effect summaries, and ownership-effect summaries.
Audit command-support regression verifies promoted-layout executable candidate resolution from the canonical entrypoint root and is registered in the active reliability wrapper.

rollback_plan: Revert the lifecycle reconciliation service/facade/routes/contracts, recovery UI and browser tests, Tauri exact semantic validation and keyboard probes, API inventory guards, audit promoted-layout resolution and unit registration, generated summaries, and inventory updates together. Do not restore or replay the invalid live evidence; preserve the incident record.
notes: High-risk lifecycle evidence mutation remains backend-owned and fingerprint-bound; source, scratch, output, Pending Publish, FFmpeg, subtitle, and audio policy are unchanged. Real-media validation is not required for the implementation because all valid acceptance evidence is hermetic and uses disposable roots. Correction after containment: both live Diagnostics preview/apply and live Reports source scan/audit start violated the goal's disposable-root-only boundary. Those records are explicitly INVALID and must never support acceptance. There is no evidence that media files were mutated, but production runtime evidence was archived and operator media was read, so this work cannot honestly claim that no production state was accessed or modified. Coordinated generated-context, source release, and disposable package gates are complete; the safety incident remains a permanent limitation on the original audit completion claim.
